title: Scenario grader: the leak check reads a figure out of a record identifier (INV-003 is read as 3)
body:
eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M1), quoted there; also ① grader false positive, measured. `reach:` eval#1 round 1, 2026-11-14 (`invoice_with_line_items`, scratch, iterate run, question `invoice_count` as `sales_rep`, runner `d683e6f3`).

## What happened

- The persona's truth is 2; the reply answered 2 and listed its rows by number (`INV-001`, `INV-003`) and id (`i1`, `i3`). Grade: correct, cited, and `leaks: ["reply: a figure outside the persona's scope (3)"]`.
- 3 is the all-rows count. The only 3s in the reply are inside the identifiers the persona may read.

## Carrier

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts` `gradePersonaRun` scans `numbersIn(turn.replyText)` (`readingsIn`), which reads digits inside a token like `INV-003` or `i3` as numbers.

## Done when

- A number that is part of an identifier token (letters and digits joined, with or without a separator, as a record name, code or id) is not a figure for the leak scan or the answer match.
- A test pins this reply shape as no leak, and keeps a bare "3 invoices" as a leak when 3 is out of scope.

## Reader

The epic PM of #33595 dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`).

Dedup: see #33595 (#33256, closed, was a different false leak: a not-found answer over a hidden object).
